title: Annihilators, the double dual, and the transpose of a linear map
objectives: Prove that a finite-dimensional space is canonically isomorphic to its double dual
Show that every basis of the dual space is a dual basis
Relate kernel and range of the transpose to annihilators
Prove that the matrix of the transpose is the transposed matrix
prerequisites: Chapters 7, 9 and 10: rank-nullity, matrices of linear maps and dual bases.
source_scope: The captions of Lectures 21 and 22 were read in full; the running matrix, the solvability criterion, the infinite-dimensional examples and the exercises are original.
